Flow.description: Works out which automatic stop codes apply to one Account (person, school or salon) using the Stop Code rules, then opens holds that should be open and ends automatic holds that no longer apply. Staff-set holds are never touched, and code 1 is ended by staff. If a code has more than one open hold, the extras are ended and the oldest kept. Runs in system context so the result does not depend on who saved the record.

formulas.name: forN_LatestPracticalAttemptNumber
formulas.description: The latest practical attempt's number (0 when blank). A failed station from an earlier attempt on the same day doesn't count against a later attempt.

formulas.name: forDT_OpenHoldEnd
formulas.description: An open hold carries 31 December 4000, because the end date is required.

formulas.name: forT_LatestPracticalResult
formulas.description: Fail when any station of the latest practical sitting failed.

formulas.name: forT_PersonOpenCodes
formulas.expression: IF({!RunStopCodePerson.StopCode01}, "StopCode01;", "") & IF({!RunStopCodePerson.StopCode04}, "StopCode04;", "") & IF({!RunStopCodePerson.StopCode05}, "StopCode05;", "") & IF({!RunStopCodePerson.StopCode06}, "StopCode06;", "") & IF({!RunStopCodePerson.StopCode07}, "StopCode07;", "") & IF({!RunStopCodePerson.StopCode08}, "StopCode08;", "") & IF({!RunStopCodePerson.StopCode09}, "StopCode09;", "") & IF({!RunStopCodePerson.StopCode15}, "StopCode15;", "") & IF({!RunStopCodePerson.StopCode17}, "StopCode17;", "") & IF({!RunStopCodePerson.StopCode20}, "StopCode20;", "") & IF({!RunStopCodePerson.StopCode21}, "StopCode21;", "") & IF({!RunStopCodePerson.StopCode31}, "StopCode31;", "")

recordLookups.name: GetCurrentLicenses
recordLookups.description: The holder's current licenses (not yet expired). Their types are left out when looking for a lapsed license for code 15.
recordLookups.label: Get Current Licenses

recordLookups.name: GetOldestOpenFee
recordLookups.description: The holder's oldest unpaid fee that has a due date. Fees with no due date (balances carried over from CLOSE) are left out, so they never hide a newer overdue fee.
recordLookups.label: Get Oldest Open Fee

recordLookups.name: GetEarliestLicense
recordLookups.description: The holder's license with the earliest expiration date, of a type they don't hold a current license for. Code 15 (restoration exam) uses it, so a lapsed license doesn't open code 15 while the person holds a current license of the same type.
recordLookups.label: Get Earliest License

recordLookups.name: GetLatestHoursEntry
recordLookups.description: The student's latest hours entry. Continuing education attendance is not student hours and is left out.
recordLookups.label: Get Latest Hours Entry

recordLookups.name: GetLatestReceivedHours
recordLookups.description: The hours entry the Board received most recently, for code 20 (180 days without hours received). Continuing education attendance is left out.
recordLookups.label: Get Latest Received Hours

recordLookups.name: GetHoursEntries
recordLookups.description: Every hours entry for the student's current course offering, to total the hours. Continuing education attendance is left out.
recordLookups.label: Get Hours Entries

recordLookups.name: GetCurrentOperatorLicense
recordLookups.description: The person's current cosmetologist, esthetician or manicurist license, if any. A booth renter needs one (code 6).
recordLookups.label: Get Current Operator License

recordLookups.name: GetOpenAlerts
recordLookups.description: Oldest first, so when a code has more than one open hold the oldest is the one kept.
recordLookups.label: Get Open Alerts
